judgments.concern: Width and height on this proposal are params.pallet_width_m 1.20 and params.pallet_height_m 0.14, the EstimatePoseParams defaults cached_prototype already passes to build_default_pallet_prototype. PalletPoseNode leaves params_ at those defaults and does not declare them as ROS parameters. dataset_replay.launch.py passes pallet_width_m and pallet_height_m only to eval_recorder_node, whose overlay uses those launch values. A successful outcome can copy the same two inputs. EstimatePoseOutcome, PoseResult, and PalletPoseStamped have no width_m, height_m, depth_m, or has_body_depth. PalletPoseStamped ends at input_depth_stamp. publish_pose writes pose.tz into both pose positions and does not read params_. pose.tz is the lifted RGB face centre. The pocket length is a separate quantity and has to be stored on the outcome before return. The far-side samples are the rows of samples.points_depth_frame whose point_to_plane_distance is strictly below the negation of cfg.plane_inlier_threshold_m. That threshold is the Stage2Config default 0.005, and the node does not override stage2_cfg_. plane_inlier_mask keeps the absolute residual at or below that threshold, and those inliers are what plane_points_3d and obs_points_2d contain. A point beyond the slab on the negative side is absent from both matrices. sample_face_points keeps a depth-frame point only when its depth is finite and inside depth_min_m 0.3 and depth_max_m 5.0 and its RGB projection hits the eroded bbox, so a pocket pixel with no return in that range is already gone. project_points_to_plane_2d writes the foot of the perpendicular on build_plane_basis_deterministic's axis_u and axis_v. best_pose.tx, best_pose.ty, and best_pose.theta_rad are locals. debug.chamfer_theta_rad keeps the angle. The 2D translation is dropped. PoseResult.tx, ty, and tz are the RGB centre. rotate_proto_into, in chamfer_detail, maps prototype rows by proto * R.transpose() with R = [[c, -s], [s, c]]. transform_points_2d is the public forward map and then adds (tx, ty). Recovering prototype coordinates subtracts (tx, ty) and applies that row map at -theta. No caller in the pipeline does that. Prototype2D stores the concatenated contour samples and origin_xy. sample_rect_contour is private to prototype.cpp and places the holes at (±pocket_centre_offset_m, 0) with sides pocket_width_m 0.47 and pocket_height_m 0.10, the node defaults. The package has no filled pocket rectangle and no point-in-rectangle test. Those rectangles can be rebuilt from params only while samples, the plane, the basis, and best_pose are still in estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2. orient_normal_toward_camera leaves normal.z() <= 0, so a point farther along depth +Z than the plane has a negative signed distance, and the negation of that distance is the length along the normal. An empty set is the proposal's has_body_depth false, and publish_pose still runs on outcome.ok. A failed estimate already publishes no PalletPoseStamped. The empty-candidate return and the depth_image_to_meters throw already publish nothing. eval_recorder_node._on_pose_rich stores pred_yaw_deg, pred_tx, pred_ty, pred_tz, n_face_points, plane_inlier_ratio, and chamfer_cost_m. geometry_msgs/PoseStamped on /pps/pallet_pose has no size fields.

This proposal's width and height are the inlier silhouette after the chamfer pose, raised to the factory face when the silhouette is shorter. obs_points_2d is the orthogonal projection of the plane inliers on axis_u and axis_v, in the same 2D frame as best_pose.tx, best_pose.ty, and best_pose.theta_rad, and it is discarded on return. A success already requires n_plane_inliers >= cfg.min_face_points (100) from finite samples, so the aligned min and max are finite whenever publish_pose runs. transform_points_2d is the public forward map: rows times R.transpose() with R = [[c, -s], [s, c]], then +(tx, ty), which is rotate_proto_into plus the translation. rotate_proto_into itself is chamfer_detail and is called on prototype rows. The silhouette shift subtracts (best_pose.tx, best_pose.ty) and applies that row map at -theta. No function in the package takes observation points through that inverse. debug.chamfer_theta_rad is the only part of best_pose that leaves the estimator, so publish_pose cannot form the span. After that inverse, x is the prototype width axis and y the height axis, the axes sample_rect_contour uses. The published width is the greater of that x span and params.pallet_width_m 1.20, and the published height is the greater of that y span and params.pallet_height_m 0.14. PalletPoseNode leaves params_ at those defaults and does not declare them. A silhouette inside the factory face therefore publishes 1.20 and 0.14. A silhouette past the factory face publishes the larger side, and the inliers are every eroded-bbox point within plane_inlier_threshold_m 0.005 of the plane. The pocket test uses sample_face_points, whose far-side rows are exactly the points plane_inlier_mask removed: signed point_to_plane_distance below the negation of that 0.005 threshold. They sit in points_depth_frame until return and are absent from obs_points_2d. Prototype2D holds contour samples, not the two pocket rectangles. Those rectangles are the private sample_rect_contour holes at (±pocket_centre_offset_m, 0) with sides 0.47 m and 0.10 m. The package has no point-in-rectangle test. orient_normal_toward_camera leaves normal.z() <= 0, and the absolute value of a negative signed distance is the length along the normal. has_body_depth and depth_m exist on neither the outcome nor PalletPoseStamped. A float64 on that message is always serialized; an unset depth_m is 0. The flag has to travel with the sizes. publish_pose runs only when outcome.ok, and a failed estimate publishes no rich pose. The two early returns in on_pair stay silent. eval_recorder_node._on_pose_rich keeps yaw, position, n_face_points, plane_inlier_ratio, and chamfer_cost_m, and the overlay sizes its quad from the recorder's own pallet_width_m and pallet_height_m.

select_detection returns one DetectionCandidate by value, nullopt on an empty list, and throws std::invalid_argument for any strategy other than highest_confidence or largest_area. The comparators are score then area_px, or area_px then score. source_index is not a key. std::max_element keeps the first maximum, and extract_detection_candidates appends in Detection2DArray order, so a tie already keeps the earlier candidate, which is the lower source_index, and leaves the later tied candidate in the vector. There is no ranked list and no Stage2Admission type. A new split that admits at most the caller count by that same first-maximum rule, and leaves every remaining candidate in extract order, matches today's winner when the count is one. A ranking that breaks the tie differently admits the other candidate. on_pair has no count parameter. detection_selection_ is the only selection input, so the node would pass a literal one. The empty-list result is the existing early return that publishes nothing. An unknown strategy still throws out of on_pair, which catches only the depth_image_to_meters exception. That depth throw happens after selection and also publishes nothing, so a split already computed for that pair is dropped. The admitted source_index is already stored as PoseResult.instance_id and FailureResult.instance_id. publish_pose and publish_failure_diagnostics never read instance_id. The deferred indices exist only in the local candidates vector. PalletPoseStamped ends at input_depth_stamp and has no index fields, and publish_pose does not receive the candidate list. On failure the only publication is a DiagnosticStatus whose values are strings: failure_reason plus the two stamps. The two lists on that path have to be encoded as text. geometry_msgs/PoseStamped on the same success path has no custom fields. eval_recorder_node._on_pose_rich copies yaw and position for one input_rgb_stamp, and _on_diagnostics skips OK statuses and stores only failure_reason from WARN. select_best_detection mirrors the single winner with Python max, which also keeps the first maximum, and stores one bbox with no source index. Detections with no results, and detections whose class does not match, are already absent from the candidate list, so the two vectors are the class-matched slots of this array. source_index is that array slot for this message.
